title: Holden show_interface Parser Result
description: Structured output of the Parser/Tool layer for the show_interface action (broker/config/action-catalog.yaml). Vendor-agnostic shape -- populated here from Linux 'ip addr show' output on the Phase 1 test lab nodes, but field meanings are chosen to also hold a future Cisco IOS-XE 'show interface' mapping without a shape change.

interface.description: Interface name as reported by the device, e.g. eth1.

admin_state.description: Administrative state -- whether the interface is enabled at all (Linux: presence of the UP flag).

oper_state.description: Operational (link-layer) state -- whether the interface actually has a carrier (Linux: presence of the LOWER_UP flag). Can be down even when admin_state is up (e.g. unplugged cable).

scope.description: e.g. link, global -- as reported by 'ip addr show'.
